description: Watch a timed-out/unknown x402 settlement: re-checked on-chain for up to 24h; POSTs your webhook when it becomes settled/failed/expired. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

amount.description: Expected amount in USDC atomic units (6 decimals), e.g. "10000" = 0.01 USDC.

apiKey.description: Your MoneyTools Settle key mts_… (alternative to the X-API-Key header). No key: call settle_trial_key.

paymentPayload.description: The x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT payload (base64 JSON or object).

tx.description: Settlement tx hash on Base, 0x + 64 hex.

webhook.description: Public https URL we POST to when the status resolves.

name: settle_watch
title: Watch timed-out settlement
